name: zclipalt_set_source_rect
description: zClipAlt::SetSourceRect copies the alternate clip source rectangle into globals, computes source width and height, and marks the source rectangle valid.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper remains deferred to a coherent zClipAlt/zModel geometry pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x476120 validates copying left, top, right, and bottom from the input RectF32, computing right-left and bottom-top as floats, setting gAltClipSourceRectValid to 1, and returning.
The native smoke verifies the copied source globals, computed width and height, and valid flag for a nonzero source rectangle.
